apworld_description: This is a manual implementation of Hades 2 for Archipelago multiworld.
At the start of the game, the player will be given a randomized weapon/aspect, keepsake, and either the Underworld or Surface path to start on.
As the player clears locations, defeats wardens/guardians, or meets NPCs, they will send items to the Archipelago.
The player will receive items from Archipelago like Arcana cards, Aspects, Keepsakes, Vows, and Grasp.
Since this is a manual implementation, it is up to the player to only use the items they have received from Archipelago to progress through the game.
As the player collects more and more Grasp, the player will be expected to progress further and further into either/both path(s).
Once the specified amount of Grasp has been collected, the player can defeat either Chronos or Typhon to claim victory.
